verdict.rationale: Codex cloud supports starting tasks from external triggers (GitHub PRs/issues, GitLab, Linear, Slack) and running them in parallel isolated cloud environments, which covers trigger-based automation, but there is no evidence of a scheduling mechanism (e.g. cron-like recurring runs) or a fully autonomous 'maintain and fix' loop without human review — results still require inspecting diffs/PRs before merge. missing for 10: explicit schedule/cron-based agent runs, evidence of unattended fix-and-merge without human approval, and independent confirmation of always-on autonomous maintenance in practice.
